title: Concept: API key field returned to a client
description: An api key or x-api-key field in a JSON body in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A returned API key authenticates as the service that owns it, so the client, its cache and any proxy in between all become holders of that identity.
applicability: Deployments that render an api key or x-api-key field in a JSON body into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A returned API key authenticates as the service that owns it, so the client, its cache and any proxy in between all become holders of that identity.
